headline: The overnight editing you asked for (ED1) is done. Security has cleared the final build of both editions, the researcher has traced every number in it and the librarian found every quote word for word with its true speaker. The editions you got with brief 40 are the final ones. One caption on the 10-page edition's page 2 promises more than its cards show, and the designer has redrawn the cards smaller, which brings page 2 to within two lines of one sheet. Both go into one more rebuild, which the team is holding until you pick 'build' or 'ship' (RL1), so that one rebuild covers all three. One new question from the publisher: which manuscript Leanpub publishes first.

items: security: both editions clear on the rails. If the words change again before you share them, they go back to security first; a layout change alone does not (security__017).

researcher: traced the final build. Every number holds and the four fixes are in. One caption names values the cards do not show; it should read 'on stage from and commits'. It also traced the Leanpub listing (two lines to change) and checked chapter 6's panel.
librarian: the final build holds in its lane, and it wrote the source twin. It is now idle until RC2's chapters arrive (librarian__014).
publisher: no rebuild this wake, as the storyteller asked: the next one waits for RL1. It drafted the Leanpub page (publisher__030).

designer: redrew the scorecards in one row; page 2 is then two lines over one sheet, not a full sheet (letter 078, publisher__030). LAB 35 has chapter 6's picture. storyteller: the 30-page edition's chapter 2 outlined for the writer.
